activities.summary: Appeared as a new entry in the DFSA public register of authorised firms (DIFC). Licence F009440, Accepting Deposits (Authorised Firms). Detected by the automated register diff; every field here is as the register publishes it and nothing has been inferred. Not yet researched or enriched. Registered address (per the DFSA): Penthouse 1,2,3 & 4, Level 8, Gate Village Building 07, DIFC, PO Box 9293, Dubai, UAE

Removed a corrupted telephone value left by a parser bug. The DFSA page renders label/value pairs, and a firm with no telephone collapses so that the next label sits where the number should be. These records had been counting as reachable when they are not.
